main_issue: Who completes Agent D's half-done analysis section before Thursday's pitch while D is at a family funeral; A first proposed splitting it, B and C declined, and D offered to finish it from home.

A-B.evidence: B refuses to cover D's section (T7); A accepts 'understood' (T8) and later accepts D's own solution (T11, T13). B never endorses the final arrangement explicitly.

A-C.evidence: A asks C to take on work (T8); C declines (T9); A drops the split and relies on D's offer (T11). C never states a view on the final arrangement.

A-D.evidence: A says 'don't worry about the presentation' and wants to split the work (T6); D offers to finish it online (T10); A accepts and thanks D (T11-13); D confirms 'I'll get it done' (T12).

B-C.evidence: Both decline to take on D's section (T7, T9); they do not address each other, and both later say only 'Take care' (T35, T39).

B-D.evidence: B declines to cover D's work (T7); D then offers to do it herself (T10), which removes the conflict. B does not respond to D directly.

C-D.evidence: C says 'I don't know how to do her analysis' (T9); D replies 'Agent C's right, the analysis is... specific' (T10) and offers to do it herself.
